name: Kwang-Gae
meaning: Honours King Kwang-Gae-Toh-Wang, the 19th king of the Koguryo Dynasty, who won back lost territory including much of Manchuria. The 39 movements refer to 391 AD, the year he took the throne, and the diagram stands for the expansion and recovery of lost land.
startingPosition: Parallel stance with a heaven hand
endingPosition: Bring the left foot back to a ready posture
diagram: Floor diagram image (kwang_gae.jpg) with points A to F, representing the expansion and recovery of lost territory.
